fields.description: Low 32 bits of the 8-byte save stamp: settings word sourced from RAM/ROM word *DAT_08022a68. Baseline 0x00009055.
fields.evidence: FUN_08022a44 builds an 8-byte stack buffer (ROM word DAT_08022a64 + settings word *DAT_08022a68) and writes it to EEPROM bytes [0,8) via FUN_0802dc5c (which programs the 8-byte page through FUN_0802f498/FUN_0802f368 DMA to DAT_0d000000). No EEPROM read path covers bytes [0,8): write-only stamp.
fields.name: global_settings_word

fields.description: Slot-0 header byte 0: read from save but never consumed before the buffer is reused.
fields.evidence: FUN_08022754 reads the 8-byte slot-0 header at save offset (sVar3+8)=8 via FUN_0802dddc into stack bytes uStack_28..bStack_24 (sVar3=0 when slot table DAT_08022878 maps slot 0 to base 0); header byte 0 (uStack_28, offset 8) is never referenced before loop reads overwrite it.
fields.name: slot0_header_byte0

fields.description: Slot-0 header byte 1: low byte of the map Y coordinate passed to the node table.
fields.evidence: FUN_08022754 header byte 1 (bStack_27, save offset 9) forms map Y as (((bStack_26 & 0xf) * 0x100 + bStack_27) * 0x3c) in the FUN_08005850(group,item,x,y,value) call that stores each node into table DAT_080058a8.
fields.name: slot0_pos_y_low

fields.description: Slot-0 header byte 2: world-unlock threshold (0=none, >=1/2/3 unlock worlds 1/2/3); high nibble feeds map X.
fields.evidence: FUN_08022754 header byte 2 (bStack_26, save offset 10): thresholds 0/1/2 gate FUN_08007e34(1/2/3) watermark raises and DAT_0802287c[0/8/0x10] |= 0x10 unlock flags; high nibble (bStack_26 >> 4) feeds map X ((bStack_25 * 0x10 + (bStack_26 >> 4)) * 0x3c) in the FUN_08005850 node-store call.
fields.name: slot0_world_unlock

fields.description: Slot-0 header byte 3: stage/level index stored to RAM and high byte of map X.
fields.evidence: FUN_08022754 header byte 3 (bStack_25, save offset 11) is stored as *DAT_08022880 = (ushort)bStack_25 and forms map X high bits ((bStack_25 * 0x10 + (bStack_26 >> 4)) * 0x3c) in the FUN_08005850 node-store call.
fields.name: slot0_stage_index

fields.description: Slot-0 header byte 4: packed config nibbles; high nibble to FUN_08007c44, low nibble to FUN_08007e24.
fields.evidence: FUN_08022754 header byte 4 (bStack_24, save offset 12) splits into FUN_08007c44(bStack_24 >> 4) config store *DAT_08007c4c and FUN_08007e24(bStack_24 & 0xf) config store *DAT_08007e30 = value + 1.
fields.name: slot0_config_packed

fields.description: Slot-0 header bytes 5-7: padding, never referenced after the 8-byte header read.
fields.evidence: FUN_08022754 reads 8 header bytes at save offset 8 via FUN_0802dddc but only consumes bytes 1-4 (bStack_27..bStack_24); bytes 5-7 (offsets 13-15) are never referenced.
fields.name: slot0_header_padding
